name: Bass fuzz growl
desc: Two-stage fuzz on bass above 120 Hz, clean lows and some clean blend: huge, riff-carrying bass

refs.why: Wolstenholme's fuzz with clean bass blended under it
fuzzed bass carrying the riffs of a two-piece band

notes: Without bass_keep a fuzz eats the fundamental; 120 Hz keeps the low E and below untouched
